note: Built 21 November 2026 for best-jazz-bars-london. Scope: anywhere a visitor goes to hear live jazz with a drink - clubs, bars, pubs and restaurants with a regular programme. Only sources dated 2023 or later. Canonical names follow the dinner-and-a-show corpus where the venue is already there; what each source wrote goes in the quote. Roving pop-ups (Hidden Jazz Club) and a dinner cruise were not recorded as venues. Boisdale is recorded as Boisdale of Canary Wharf because every jazz source names that branch. Brasserie Zédel (Reddit) and The Crazy Coqs are left apart: the room is in the brasserie's basement, but the threads may mean the restaurant. Reddit and TikTok records are copied from the dinner-and-a-show corpus, where the threads ask for dinner with live jazz.
